description: 1. Read ~/.config/cloudflare/r2.json to extract bucket ('ecommerce-assets-prod'), publicDomain ('pub-7f3e2d1c9b8a4056.r2.dev'), accountId, and apiToken. The agent must NOT use the decoy config at workspace/config/storage.json. 2. Run `scripts/r2-upload.sh marketing/campaign_q4/ campaigns/q4-launch/` (batch directory upload), which internally calls `wrangler r2 object put <bucket>/<remote-path> --file <local-file> --remote` for each of the 7 files. The --remote flag is mandatory per the SKILL.md and must not be omitted. 3. The correct remote paths must be `campaigns/q4-launch/<filename>` for each file. 4. Create cdn_urls.txt in the workspace root with one URL per file in the format `https://pub-7f3e2d1c9b8a4056.r2.dev/campaigns/q4-launch/<filename>` — using the publicDomain from the config, NOT the bucket name or any other domain.
